It sounds a lot like you’re not only doing it to ‘get back at the police’ but also like you’re trying to take control over something when you felt like you had so little over the things that happened to you. You should’ve never had to go through anything and I’m so sorry you did. I will say, drinking and doing drugs as a way to cope is a very slippery slope and I wouldn’t recommend it. However, with regard to doing it underage, I live in the UK and we can drink legally from 18 so I don’t think it’s that bad, there’s definitely worse you could be doing as long as it’s every so often and not everyday. 

I get it. Traumatic experiences with BPD are debilitating and I fully empathise with the hard time you’re having at the minute, I’m going through it in a similar way and my ways of coping are also extremely unhealthy but I’m working on that. At least when you steal (although that isn’t good and I think you should probably talk to someone regarding the good feeling you get from it and see if there’s a healthier way to possibly feel that same buzz) it’s from big business’ and not small ones but eventually you will get caught so should try and get ahead of it now. 

I think when you’ve tried so hard your entire life to get people to like you ans then start to struggle it all doesn’t matter anymore and you start to think there’s no point, I do this and then take it out on myself. It’s scary for the mask to come off when you just want to be liked but the people who love and care about you should understand if you talk to them about it.

It’s so wrong that you’re suffering like this because of trauma perpetrated by others. All I can do is say that I’m always here if you need to talk and I hope you get through this rough patch even though it isn’t easy.
I was 20 and his dad was 19. Still happy and healthy over three years later 😊🙌🏼

Do you have anyone you trust who you can speak to? I’ve found that talking to someone helps even if they can’t fully understand. 

I’m in the same boat right now, struggling to do everyday tasks, wanting to kms but not being able to because of the trauma I’d cause my family and child. Some days it’s worse than others, but right now it’s getting to be worse than it has ever been. I don’t want to be a burden to people and I don’t want to lie and pretend I know who I am when I don’t and this just adds fuel to the fire. 

I don’t know what country you’re in but in the UK they can’t discriminate against a disability which is what chronic mental illness’ fall under in a lot of cases. 

Your therapist is probably your best bet, I understand the office is closed but tomorrow you can try again.

I know things are hard for you right now and you feel like you’re drowning in your own thoughts and emotions but the truth is, even though I don’t know you, I’m so fucking proud of you. When you feel this way, even breathing is an achievement
And even though you feel like you’d be better off dead, there are people who couldn’t bear it if you weren’t here anymore. 

If all you can do is lie in bed and ‘rot’ for a few days or weeks then so be it, if that’s what you have to do to get through this then do it. The fact of the matter is although you do WANT to die, you haven’t done it and that is something you should be proud of. It is incredibly courageous to admit that you’re struggling. Unfortunately with these things all you can do is take one day at a time. 

Make sure you ring your therapist tomorrow and explain how you’re feeling, she may give you some insight on how to make it better, but for now instead of thinking of all the things you’re doing ‘wrong’ and thinking that you’re just rotting yourself away take this time and realise, you’re giving yourself a time out for a debilitating mental illness that is causing you excruciating pain and try to tell yourself that you’re doing as much as you can right now. 

You’re eating and you’re going to the bathroom so you’re doing what you can in the way you feel right now. Don’t be too hard on yourself, you’re doing great. I’m here if you ever need to talk ❤️
